component.name: Powertool
component.summary: Enhanced productivity suite featuring Offline Translation and Keyboard Layout Conversion

description.p: Powertool Extended Edition is an enhanced productivity suite developed independently by En-Dhiaa. It brings offline neural machine translation (Arabic ↔ English), physical keyboard layout correction, and extensive system tools to both Windows and Linux desktops (supporting GNOME, KDE, X11, and Wayland).

ul.li: Physical Keyboard Layout Converter (US QWERTY ↔ Arabic 101/102)
Global shortcuts and system tray integration
Zero cloud dependency, 100% private local execution

description.p: Initial release of Powertool Extended Edition by En-Dhiaa featuring Offline Translator and Keyboard Layout Converter.
